resources.string: Quick and light. Needs the spoken language chosen and downloaded above.
Fewer mistakes, detects the language and can translate into English. Slower.
Small — most accurate, slow on older phones
Choose a model (downloaded once, then works offline)

Whisper makes fewer mistakes than the fast engine, understands about 100 languages and can translate them into English. It takes longer to write subtitles, especially with the Small model. Models are downloaded once from the whisper.cpp project on Hugging Face.
Whisper writes English subtitles whatever language is spoken
Off. Enter your own free API key to look for subtitles while casting a video.
On — tap \"Find subtitles\" while casting a video
On, logged in as %1$s — tap \"Find subtitles\" while casting a video

Get a free API key on opensubtitles.com (your profile → API consumers). Nothing is sent until you tap \"Find subtitles\" while casting. Then the video\'s file name and its OpenSubtitles fingerprint (a hash of its size and of two small pieces of the file) go to OpenSubtitles.com. Username and password are optional and give you more downloads per day. Everything is stored encrypted on this phone.
Results marked \"Matches your file\" were made for exactly this file.
